title: Mai Kula da Alamar Allah
intro: A cikin wani wuri mai tsarki, an renon wata rai mai albarka a ƙarƙashin kulawar Allah. An ƙaddara wannan mutumin ya taka muhimmiyar rawa a cikin wani abin al'ajabi, wanda ya zama shaida ga ikon Allah da hikimarsa mara iyaka. Tafiyarsu ta bayyana gaskiya mai zurfi, tana ƙalubalantar fahimta da kuma kafa wata alama ta musamman ga dukkan bil'adama.
clues: Allah ya zaɓe ni kuma ya tsarkake ni fiye da dukkan mata na zamanina.
An sanya ni ƙarƙashin kulawar wani annabi mai adalci, wanda ya sami abinci mai kyau a ɗakin addu'ata.
Na keɓe kaina daga iyalina zuwa wani wuri na sirri don bauta wa Allah.
Mala'ika ya bayyana a gare ni a cikin siffar mutum cikakke, yana kawo mini albishir game da ɗa tsarkakakke, ko da yake ban san wani namiji ba.
Bayan na haihu, an umarce ni da in girgiza jikin bishiyar dabino don in sami abinci mai daɗi.
Da na koma wurin mutanenmu dauke da jaririyata, sai suka yi min tambayoyi, amma jaririyata ta yi magana ta mu'ujiza daga cikin jaririyata don kare ni.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds. (3:42)
